items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: Greg will start playing like a D over the A minor that Ben is rolling you know... Ben could often times introduce a progression

ctx.x: Yeah. Enough of this vamp, right? No. So we’re patient, we’re conservative, and we really keep open ears across the board, whether feeding each other motifs or progressing the structure along.

Yeah. A lot of changes will happen like live with just like, you know, someone will introduce a new chord, you know, Greg will start playing like a D over the A minor that Ben is rolling you know. And then we all hear him and we’re like all right, let’s follow that. You know. And or Ben could often times introduce a progression when we land into like, oh if we’re in a one-chord jam like Ben could suddenly introduce a chord progression on the bass you know, usually revolving around some chord tones to keep it safe…
Do you ever break into a swing groove?
